extracted.name: M' Sweet gals
extracted.description: Its so soft and since bite size.. Sweet gals makes best mid day snacks for all..
instruction_lines: Mix all the ingredients expect oil using water to make thick batter leave it for two minutes.

Meanwhile heat oil in paniyaram pan.Once hot enough pour the batter using spoon in the cavities of the pan. Maida cooks fast..Once it starts to rice like balls.Turn it.Take it out little brown.Its ready to serve.
Sweet gals are hit with children and sweet tooth adults,its best served with glass of milk or chocolate syrup.
